title: First official fork release
highlights: Jcode's independent hard-fork release line starts at v1.0.0
Nix and the public jerudnik-jcode Cachix cache are the only binary distribution authority
GitHub Releases are metadata-only and carry release notes and source/tag metadata without executable assets
improvements: Release evidence now ties Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, CHANGELOG.md, structured changelog notes, SBOM, provenance, install, and rollback checks to the same v1.0.0 release name
The release contract rejects old v0.* tags as official fork-release proof and requires a main-ancestor rollback ref before publication
fixes: Resolved the release gate mismatch where release_check.py expected v1.0.0 but the package version still reported 0.46.0
